title: 发烧是身体在打仗
subtitle: 热起来，是为了赢
character: wearing light blue pyjamas and thick socks, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, soft watercolour with gentle washes and fine grey-blue outlines, palette of pale blue, soft rose and cream, calm and reassuring, plenty of clean paper

pages.zh:
妈妈的手贴在我额头上，
说：有点烫。
我躺在床上，
身上一会儿冷，
一会儿又热。
pages.scene: The little boy lies in bed in blue pyjamas with a blanket pulled up, a grown adult woman's hand resting on his forehead, warm lamplight.

pages.zh:
有很小很小的病菌
进到身体里来了。
它们小得看不见，
可是会让我们不舒服。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: several small round specks with short spikes clustered on a pale background, all the same kind. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
身体里有一支队伍，
叫「白细胞」。
它们在血里巡逻，
一发现病菌，
就围上去。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one large round cell on a pale background surrounded by six smaller spiky specks, with arrows pointing from the cell toward them. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
打仗需要条件。
病菌怕热，
白细胞却在热一点的时候
跑得更快。
所以身体决定：把温度调高。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two thermometers side by side on a pale background: the left one with the liquid at a lower mark, the right one with the liquid clearly higher. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
大脑里有个小开关，
把身体的目标温度
往上调了一格。
于是我们觉得冷、发抖，
身体是在给自己加热。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one dial on a pale background with a pointer moved from a lower position to a higher one, and one curved arrow showing the turn. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
打赢了以后，
开关就调回来。
这时候我们会出汗，
身体把多出来的热
放掉。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one dial on a pale background with the pointer moved back down, and three small drops beside it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
所以发烧本身不是病，
是身体在打仗。
它说明那支队伍
正在工作。
pages.scene: One child lying in bed under a blanket on a pale background, eyes closed, resting quietly. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
打仗很费力气。
所以要多喝水、多睡觉，
把力气省给那支队伍。
吃得清淡一点也好。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: three small symbols in a row on a pale background: a glass of water, a bed, and a bowl. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
量体温要量准。
把体温计放好，
安安静静等一会儿，
不要刚跑完、
刚洗完澡就量。
pages.scene: One thermometer lying on a pale background beside a small clock, drawn plainly. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
大部分发烧，
过两三天就好了。
温度上上下下是正常的，
晚上常常比白天高一点。
pages.scene: One gentle wavy line across a pale background, rising and falling three times, drawn simply. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
可是有几种情况要去看医生：
烧得很久不退，
或者精神很差、
一直不想喝水。
那就要告诉大人。
pages.scene: One friendly grown-up doctor in a white coat on a pale background, standing beside a chair, drawn plainly. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
第三天早上，
我醒过来，
额头凉凉的。
妈妈笑了。
身体那支队伍，已经打完仗了。
pages.scene: The little boy sits up in bed in the morning light, stretching, looking rested and cheerful.
